definitions.gloss: to be deeply grateful; to feel deeply obliged
definitions.explanation: A formal and humble expression of gratitude, indicating that one feels so grateful it almost hurts. Used in polite business and social situations.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧{痛|いた}み{入|い}ります。
examples.english: I am deeply grateful for your kindness.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{忙|いそが}しいところ→お忙しいところ：23577_oisogashiitokoro⟧、⟦わざわざ→わざわざ：06073_wazawaza⟧⟦お{越|こ}し→お越し：07322_okoshi⟧⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、{痛|いた}み{入|い}ります。
examples.english: I am deeply grateful that you took the trouble to come despite being so busy.

examples.japanese: {度重|たびかさ}なるご⟦{配慮|はいりょ}→配慮：07700_hairyo⟧、まこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{痛|いた}み{入|い}る⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦でございます→でございます：19539_degozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: I am truly and deeply grateful for your repeated consideration.

notes:
{痛|いた}み{入|い}る is a godan verb used as a very formal expression of gratitude. Literally "the gratitude enters to the point of pain." It is intransitive.

ASPECT (ている):
Not typically used in て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form. The present tense {痛|いた}み{入|い}ります is the standard polite expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧{痛|いた}み{入|い}ります (I am deeply grateful for your kindness)
- {痛|いた}み{入|い}る⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧です (I am truly grateful — very formal)
- まこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{痛|いた}み{入|い}ります (I am truly deeply grateful)

REGISTER:
This is a highly formal and humble expression, appropriate for business correspondence and formal speech. It would sound out of place in casual conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {痛|いた}み{入|い}る: deeply grateful (very formal, humble)
- ⟦{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}る→恐れ入る：05914_osoreiru⟧: to be sorry, to be grateful (formal, humble)
- ありがたい: grateful, thankful (general)
